steps.title: Tell NOVA about your business
steps.completion_rule: A brand profile exists for the organization.

steps.title: Add your products
steps.completion_rule: At least one product draft exists.

steps.title: NOVA builds your catalog
steps.completion_rule: At least one product draft has generated content (or was accepted/rejected).

steps.title: Review AI-generated content
steps.completion_rule: Every product draft has been accepted or rejected.

steps.title: Build your storefront
steps.completion_rule: A storefront draft generated by NOVA exists (the auto-created blank default does not count).

steps.title: Preview your storefront
steps.completion_rule: The generated draft's preview has loaded successfully in the storefront app.

steps.title: Ask NOVA to improve it
steps.completion_rule: A storefront Change Plan was proposed and then applied to the draft.

steps.title: Publish your store
steps.completion_rule: The owner published the generated draft (the pre-seeded demo baseline does not count).

steps.title: Learn how NOVA runs your business
steps.completion_rule: A Store Manager health review completed and produced an action plan.
